about: The fingerprint of the DEFINITIVE 3D structure of Kowloon Walled City (src/city/) and of the data of its surroundings (src/surroundings/), frozen on 2026-11-04 (docs/structure.md). tools/check_structure.mjs fails when the structure no longer gives these values. Change the structure only for a large error that a new source shows, and only with John's approval; then run node tools/check_structure.mjs --refreeze and say why in docs/structure.md. city: a SHA-256 of the City model; mesh: a SHA-256 of the geometry that src/city/mesh.js makes of it (not the colours); surroundings: a SHA-256 of each data file of the surroundings and of their shapes (tools/structure_fingerprint.mjs).
